== Reflections foil source audit, 13 November 2026 ==
The actual photographed foil (PSA certificate 68373908) was read independently: unique; destiny 1; power 3; ability 4; deploy 3; forfeit 7; Pilot and Warrior; no expansion symbol; revised game text beginning “You may activate 1 extra Force each turn if Luke is not at a Tatooine site.” Lore matches the photographed card. Landspeed 1 is the character rule default, not a printed number.

The article has a stable publication ID and uses the shared Premiere Luke family navigator. No new numeric GEMP family was allocated and no foil-modifier mapping is advertised. The source scan is retained complete in its grading holder; a cleaner card-only scan can replace its display later without changing this publication identity. The ordinary Japanese and Japanese Reflections III foil remain separate publications.
